title: SAP Data in Microsoft Fabric: Choosing an Integration Route That Lasts
blurb: Every route from SAP into Microsoft Fabric on one map, rated for compliance, cost and readiness. I host; Markus Heinen and Bartosz Kłos make up the panel. One live hour, in English.

title: Same Event, Half the Grind: Event Management with Alibaba Cloud AI
blurb: One 1,500-attendee conference run through the full event cycle twice, the way it runs today and the way it runs with AI, with live demos. Co-presented with Nico Bühler of Alibaba Cloud. Everyone who registers gets our event skill library afterwards: ten ready-to-use playbooks for AI agents. Free, one hour, in English.

title: St. Galler Produktionsmanagement-Tagung
venue: University of St. Gallen — Hotel Einstein, St. Gallen
blurb: This year's theme: “Shaping the Future: The New Rules of Industrial Competitiveness”.

title: Slaying Dragons with AI
blurb: Build your own local AI agent system in the room, then use it on something that matters to you. Bring a laptop and an AI tool that can reach local files.

title: Slaying Dragons with AI — WAVE Fellowship
blurb: A 90-minute hands-on session for the fellowship cohort: build a working local AI agent system, then point it at a future-self goal-setting exercise. Co-presented with Franziska-J. Klebôn.

title: Slaying Dragons with AI — Berlin Immersion
venue: Tomorrow University of Applied Sciences, Berlin
blurb: 60 minutes, 40 attendees, four working prototypes by the end of the hour. The write-up is the honest version, including what stopped the other thirty-six.
